resources.string: Choose how the panel trades image quality for response speed. Balanced is recommended for most apps.
More speed means fewer shades and more ghosting
This global mode applies unless an app has its own profile.
Balanced — Recommended\nFast while scrolling; sharper for taps, dialogs, and still pages.
Balanced — Recommended\nClear AUTO updates for ordinary use; choose A2 explicitly for continuous scrolling.
Normal — Clear grayscale\nSharp text and images with moderate response and little ghosting.
Speed — Fast text\nQuick page turns using fewer shades; some trails may remain.
A2 — Fastest motion\nBest for rapid scrolling; lowest detail and the most ghosting.
Regal — Cleanest page\nReduces ghosting on static reading pages; responds more slowly.
Reader — Fast page turns\nUses DU for pages and performs GC16 only at the selected page interval.
Per-app profiles still take precedence over the global default.

Technical values below match the current Leaf3 EBC bridge implementation. Waveform numbers are vendor EBC IDs.
Composer-native EPDC sends compositor damage with the matching HWC frame. Waveform numbers are vendor IDs; capture timing lines below apply only to bridge mode.

BALANCED / ADAPTIVE
Waveform: AUTO (5) for taps and still content; ANIM (4) only while scrolling
Capture target: 100 ms / 10 Hz
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering
Cleanup: regional GC16 after scrolling stops
Purpose: preserve UI quality while keeping scrolling responsive

NORMAL / AUTO
Waveform: AUTO (5)
Capture target: 140 ms / about 7 Hz
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering
Cleanup: normally unnecessary; required if scrolling switches to ANIM
Purpose: stable general grayscale rendering

SPEED / DU
Waveform: DU (1)
Capture target: 80 ms; EBC submission remains capped at 10 Hz
Tone handling: fast, reduced grayscale fidelity
Cleanup: regional GC16 after the screen becomes quiet
Purpose: quick text and page movement

A2 / ANIMATION
Waveform: ANIM (4)
Capture target: 80 ms; EBC submission remains capped at 10 Hz
Tone handling: lowest detail, strongest residual ghosting
Cleanup: regional GC16 after the screen becomes quiet
Purpose: maximum motion responsiveness

REGAL / ANTI-GHOST
Waveform: REGAL (6)
Capture target: 140 ms / about 7 Hz
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering and cleaner residuals
Cleanup: normally unnecessary; required if scrolling switches to ANIM
Purpose: high-quality static reading pages

READER / PAGE-TURN
Waveform: DU (1) for page turns; GC16 (2) at the selected interval
Capture target: newest frame at the 100 ms EBC deadline
Scrolling: ANIM (4), independently of page counting
Purpose: low-latency reading without cleaning after every page

BALANCED / AUTO
Waveform: AUTO (5) for compositor damage
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering
Cleanup: regional GC16 after prior fast updates become quiet
Purpose: preserve UI quality for taps, dialogs, and still pages

NORMAL / AUTO
Waveform: AUTO (5) for compositor damage
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering
Cleanup: normally unnecessary
Purpose: stable general grayscale rendering

SPEED / DU
Waveform: DU (1) for compositor damage
Tone handling: fast, reduced grayscale fidelity
Cleanup: regional GC16 after the screen becomes quiet
Purpose: quick text and page movement

A2 / ANIMATION
Waveform: ANIM (4) for compositor damage
Tone handling: lowest detail, strongest residual ghosting
Cleanup: regional GC16 after the screen becomes quiet
Purpose: maximum motion responsiveness

REGAL / ANTI-GHOST
Waveform: REGAL (6); large changes use AUTO (5) first
Tone handling: grayscale with dithering and cleaner residuals
Settled pass: REGAL after 180 ms of quiet
Purpose: high-quality static reading pages

READER / PAGE-TURN
Waveform: DU (1) for compositor damage; full-screen GC16 (2) after page motion settles at the selected interval
Page gestures: each dominant horizontal swipe counts once; vertical scrolling does not count
Static pages: large tap or button replacements count after 180 ms of quiet
Purpose: low-latency reading without cleaning after every page

Shared rules
• Scroll detection overrides every mode with ANIM (4) while motion is active.
• Large Regal changes use AUTO first and a settled REGAL pass after 180 ms of quiet.
• “Clean screen now” submits a full-panel GC16 (2).
• EBC submissions are at least 100 ms apart; pending notifications coalesce before capture.
• Regional cleanup waits for 300 ms (Quality) or 600 ms (Balanced) of quiet; Reader uses its page interval instead.

Composer-native rules
• All visible layers use client composition so application content, system bars, and dialogs reach the E-Ink framebuffer.
• Damage is sent as up to eight rectangles with the matching HWC present; larger batches collapse to one bounding rectangle.
• Touch-driven moving view regions temporarily use ANIM while surrounding damage keeps the selected waveform.
• Large Regal changes use AUTO first and a settled REGAL pass after 180 ms of quiet.
• “Clean screen now” submits a full-panel GC16 (2).
• Regional cleanup waits for 300 ms (Quality) or 600 ms (Balanced) of quiet; Reader uses its page interval instead.
Tap an app to override its waveform, tone, cleanup interval, or animation behavior. Unset controls inherit the global values.
Use global default\nFollow the mode selected on the Refresh page.
Property animations finish immediately in this foreground app. Touch-driven scrolling remains responsive through short-lived view-region ANIM hints.
Fine-tune responsiveness, battery use, and how quickly fast-update ghosting is cleaned.

Composer-native EPDC is active. Touch-driven moving view regions receive transient ANIM hints. Idle capture, raw-input fallback detection, sleep-screen rendering, contrast, and gamma belong to the screenshot bridge and remain unavailable. Refresh modes, dithering, Reader cleanup, settled Regal, and regional ghost cleanup remain active.
How often the bridge checks an unchanged screen. Touch always wakes it immediately.
Quality cleans sooner; Manual disables regional and Reader interval cleanup until “Clean screen now.”
Choose what remains on the E-Ink panel while Android is asleep. The Android lock screen appears after wake.
Choose a sleep image before selecting Custom image.
Adjust brightness and the balance between cool and warm LEDs without leaving the app.
Live display-backend state and performance counters. Values update when this page opens or when you press refresh.
Changing the display backend requires a reboot. Bridge is the safe fallback; Composer provides lower latency but is experimental.
Composer-native mode will force all visible layers into the E-Ink framebuffer and reboot the device. This mode is experimental; switch back to Bridge if the panel misbehaves.
The device will reboot into the compatible screenshot-bridge backend.
The backend was saved, but automatic reboot failed. Reboot the device manually to apply it.
